removed: Before measurement record exact Source/implementation/runner/profile/artifact/fixture/library/compiler identities, invocation and durability mode. Declare workload cardinalities, operation rate/mix, key/item/body sizes, replay locality, checkpoint policy, concurrency and input bytes; record CPU, RAM, storage/filesystem/mount/cache facts relevant to the experiment. The [first approved budgets](#first-approved-budgets) apply to the envelope named there. Cache/eligible-GC, output and cancellation budgets are not approved yet. Each of them, like the budgets of [P/01.3](01.3-store.norms.md) R035 and R036, is a finite positive budget declared by the implementation, and the probe of a dependent case receives its value as input from the environment (ADR-0130 Addendum (5) item 3). The implementation declares the value; the threshold of production acceptance is approved as in ADR-0130 Addendum (9), and a claim of the candidate alone is not enough (ADR-0130 Addendum (15) item 7). The stop budget fits below the actual manager stop deadline with measured teardown margin. Calibrate monotonic resolution/scheduling uncertainty separately; it does not increase a protocol budget. Candidate assertions alone do not qualify these inputs. Unknown values stay unknown, not invented universal defaults.
